decisions.reason: Submarine interior lighting is a niche project far from the core business, but naval contracts are long-cycle and the expanding firm has the slack to carry it while it extends the maritime competence it already holds.

Explosion-proof industrial luminaires build on the firm's certified engineering, are actively developed (a new LED replacement kit was added), and serve a growing industrial market, so they meet aspirations.
The relaunched designer task light is close to the core offer and cheap to maintain, though the design-driven task-light segment is competitive and may be pruned if sales disappoint.

The pendant office luminaire fits the firm's core building-lighting business and its LED energy-efficiency strategy, with no signal of underperformance that would trigger search for other uses of its resources.
The premium pendant luminaire complements the office range close to the established offer, and in a growing industry the firm's slack lets it keep the product while its results mature.
